Save a repository to / load a repository from the repository store

Source: R/save-objects.R
repo_store.Rd

save_repository() writes a repository into the content-addressed store <repositories_path>/<name>/ (see get_repositories_path()): a repository.yml manifest, the thinned repo.RData, and parquet stores for the large data slots. Saving identical content again is a no-op. The repository is registered in the project registry unless registry = FALSE. A stored repository can then be REFERENCED by models instead of embedded — see save_model()'s embed_repos.

load_repository() resolves a stored repository by name (optionally "name@hash8", or with hash =) via the registry first, then by scanning the store; path bypasses resolution.

Usage

save_repository(
  repo,
  path = NULL,
  embed_datasets = NULL,
  registry = TRUE,
  format = get_storage_format(),
  overwrite = FALSE,
  rehash = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

load_repository(name, hash = NULL, path = NULL, env = NULL, verbose = TRUE)

Arguments

repo

a repository object.

path

character, explicit store directory (bypasses the registry).

embed_datasets

NULL (default), TRUE, or FALSE — whether the big data tables (weather/demand) are embedded in this entry or stored as references into the dataset store (see save_dataset()). NULL references whatever identical content is already stored and embeds the rest; TRUE always embeds; FALSE requires a store hit and errors otherwise. Mirrors embed_repos / embed_model one level down.

registry

logical, add/refresh the registry row on save.

format

storage format for the data slots (as in save_scenario()).

overwrite

logical, rewrite the store entry even when the hash matches.

rehash

logical; FALSE keeps the DESTINATION entry's recorded hash while writing the changed content — for changes the user declares insignificant (a description, a memo). The manifest marks the exception (hash_kept: true); references then verify against the retained hash. With rehash = FALSE the hash is a user-managed version tag, not a content proof.

verbose

logical.

name

character, repository name, "name@hash8", or a store directory path.

hash

character, full or short content hash to pin a version.

env

environment to assign the repository into by name, or NULL (default) to return it.

Value

save_repository() the repository, invisibly (with misc$hash / misc$path recording the store entry); load_repository() the repository object (or invisible(TRUE) when assigned into env).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
open_project(tempdir())

repo <- newRepository("my_repo", newCommodity("ELC", unit = "MWh"))
save_repository(repo)

load_repository("my_repo")
} # }
